2020-11-03|LA|psc-district-1.nt: Louisiana's open primary, held on the general election date: every candidate, of every party or none, on one ballot, party labels printed. A candidate with more than half the votes is elected; otherwise the leading candidates meet in a runoff on December 5, 2020. No candidate won the seat outright: Allen H. Borne, Jr. and Eric Skrmetta went on to the runoff of December 5, 2020, stored as its own contest. Voted in Ascension, Jefferson, Livingston, Orleans, Plaquemines, St. Bernard, St. Charles, St. Helena, St. Tammany, Tangipahoa, Washington Parishes.

2020-11-03|LA|psc-district-1-runoff.nt: The runoff, held on December 5, 2020, of the November 3 open primary for this office, between the choices the Secretary of State marked 'Runoff' then. It is stored with the November election because this store keeps one election a year; its own date is the one in its title. Figures from the December results, which the Secretary marks official. Voted in Ascension, Jefferson, Livingston, Orleans, Plaquemines, St. Bernard, St. Charles, St. Helena, St. Tammany, Tangipahoa, Washington Parishes.
